# Session Five

## Plan

- The company are going to 10-11 followed by Inis Ocular to gather the levy
- When appropriate have flash backs of time skip doings from Kindlemass to Levy.
- The water outside Klaegcasleen is frozen so they will have to go by horses and wagons to 10-11 followed by boat to Inis Ocular
    - Boats and boatsmen on wagons
    - The Mule Knight (disguised) is amongst the people helming the wagons
- A base has been set up at 10-11 where clay is being gathered
    - [Bray](/cast/klaegcasleen_vassals.qmd#bray) has passed away, buried under a mound of red clay
    - [Hygo](/cast/fabriknock_vassals.qmd#hygo) (Bray's apprentice) is fishing and is here to take over bray's work
- Possible idea
    - When they get back to Klaegcasleen they will vote for a religious role in the seat of power called The Proxy
    - Only Knights can vote
    - The Violet Knight will be there for this
    - If The Child was saved and brought to Klaegcasleen The War Knight will vote for The Proxy to be created
    - If successful The War knight will suggest The Child be The Proxy

## Time skips

Time skip events happened throughout the session as flashbacks.
Time skip between Kindlemass to Levy

- The Salt Knight
    - Socialised with the soldiers of The Horn Knight
    - Spoke about reinforcing which the soldiers like
    - THey dod not like the idea of attacking The Horn Knights otters
    - Instead get the Horn Knight on the company's side by offering better lodging for the otter family
- The Story Knight
    - Conversed with The Fanged Knight over drinks
    - Fanged told them about the Mule
    - Used his fangs to put the story to sleep under his request

## Travel

The ice has frozen over so the knights and the boatsmen join a caravan of mules and wagons.
The Mule Knight (disguised) leads the caravan.

## Day 2 morning

10-11

- Travelling along the coast
- Child 3 (myth hex)
    - A seeker knight in a shallow lake amongst mist
    - The Knight wants to Kill the Child and attacks the company as they will not join his cause

## Day 2 afternoon

11-11

- They get on the boat with the [Boatmen](/cast/klaegcasleen_vassals.qmd#boatmen): Alfonsion, Bream, and Dace
- Heading towards Inis Ocular
- However a sea serpent with the face of a catfish appears and an island appears with a house of light so they escape to the island
- Child omen 4
- At the ground floor they find a crib with a serpent rattle which The STory Knight takes
- Rattling the rattle they hear a scream and wailing from the top of the lighthouse where a powerful light is
- They go up to the top where The Burning mother acts as the light
- She attacks The STory Knight whilst the other knights freeze
- He fights her off and pushes her off the light house where she lays still
- Until she doesn't and enters the bottom of the lighthouse attacking The boatmen
- Dace gets a little crispy whilst the other hide behind leather
- The Silk Knight fires her bow finishing off the burning mother

11-11

    - The father was tricked, and the killed by The Burning Mother

Moving to Inis Ocular
